data.text: I’ll commit to 15 tons and donate the full $15,000, provided John and Kate join Emma and me at 15 each and Luke confirms zero. That gets the clinic its $60,000 today while leaving 40 tons to replenish the lake. I’ll also commit to 6 tons next month, then 10 each once we’re back at 100. Let’s review the actual stock and everyone’s catches before setting next month’s limits. John, are you in on the donation and recovery plan?
